summary: KEPCO filed a Form 6-K to announce the closure of its shareholders registry from September 12 to September 22, 2026, for an upcoming extraordinary general meeting of shareholders. The record date for voting rights is September 11, 2026. This is a routine EGM notice and record-date administrative filing, not a special situation. No deal terms, proposals, or extraordinary transactions are mentioned. There is no activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action that would qualify for a special-situation classification. The filing simply provides procedural information for shareholders.
